title: Chapter 703
paragraphs: Chapter 703
Episode 179. Unavoidable Trap (2)
"How severe is the damage?"
"It's serious. The capital of the Milcoon Kingdom has completely disappeared, and the estimated number of civilian casualties is over two hundred thousand."
Upon hearing the number two hundred thousand, Jin thought he had misheard.
"...Did you say two hundred thousand?"
If that's true, then Difus has committed an irreparable massacre of civilians.
The Tona brothers who were listening also gritted their teeth, and Meri turned deathly pale.
Her fists were shaking as she barely managed to hold back her emotions.
Even if Difus eventually breaks free from the chaos, this enormous tragedy cannot be undone.
It drove the brothers to madness.
"...There are also at least ten thousand people taken hostage."
As Kashimir continued his explanation with a somber face, Jin felt as if his whole body was submerged in water.
"Rosa... this insane monster...!"
A huge disaster had occurred, and it was inevitably caused by his brother who had become Rosa's weapon of war.
Jin's eyes were trembling as he looked at Kashimir.
"So, if there are ten thousand hostages, does it mean the Chaos Dragon of Evil Spirit and the Black Lines have moved?"

"Yes, they attacked the Lutero Magic Federation simultaneously under the command of Sir Difus. In the process, the abilities of the Evil Spirit that are believed to be instant teleportation or summoning in the form of a large dimensional door, and earth tunnels, were used."
The Lutero Magic Federation couldn't respond properly.
It's impossible to quickly respond to hundreds of Black Lines and thousands of Chaos Dragons that suddenly emerge from earth tunnels and dimensional doors, unless it's the main base of Drakka.

What's more, Difus launched a diversionary operation. He first appeared leading a fleet around Drakka as if to start a full-scale invasion, then disappeared like smoke while Ziffel was hastily assembling troops, wreaking havoc everywhere in the Federation.
One hour.
The Chaos army led by Difus managed to inflict huge damage on Ziffel and successfully escape in just one hour. The Drakka forces couldn't keep up with the mobility of the Chaos army.
Moreover, there was a problem with Difus' invisibility. Octavia and the Phantom Brigade were unable to penetrate the chaos energy he emitted even once during the pursuit.
The world's number one power was unable to use its full strength and suffered.
The affected areas of the Federation, including the Milcoon Kingdom, are currently in utter chaos.
The chaos left by Difus was like an uncontrollable wildfire, still causing suffering to the remaining civilians.
The death toll exceeding 200,000 means that the number of injured is much greater.
Even the Holy Kingdom, which had been cutting off all communication with Ziffel, began to dispatch healers as soon as they heard the news.
Fear spread insanely quickly.

As the territory of Ziffel, which had been considered the safest barrier against any monster in the world, was taken so defenselessly, many people said that the end brought on by the Evil Spirit was just a matter of time.
Throughout Kashimir's explanation, Jin was taking deep breaths.
His task was not to sink into sorrow, but to stop Difus as soon as possible, even if it's just a day sooner.
He had to understand the situation accurately.
"I must go to Drakka immediately. In case the Evil Spirit attacks while I'm absent, please activate all defensive equipment."
Now that it had been revealed that Rosa has abilities like massive teleportation, a battle could break out suddenly at any time.
'Such large-scale summoning, teleportation abilities wouldn't be without constraints. It must be using humans, or despair. Perhaps the reason for kidnapping hostages is to meet that quota.'

The terror experienced by those already under the direct rule of the Evil Spirit and the sudden fear felt by those who thought they were living on 'safe' land would have been different. The size of the resulting despair was sure to be different.
Whether Rosa has ample power to move troops or not, he couldn't know at this moment.
"I understand, teacher."
"And where is Siris?"
"He just returned from the Holy Kingdom."
"It would be best for you to visit Kinsel with Siris's help. Also, please check on the empire. There's a possibility they've been attacked as well."
"I will do so."
As Jin and Kashimir turned to leave, Meri watched their backs before turning back towards the healing room, overcoming her heart that felt like it would collapse.
"There's going to be a big fight soon. If you want to fight properly, you need to concentrate on recovery, so prepare the knights of our house."
"Yes, sister!"
Even as Jin headed for the Red Owl's departure area, reports from Chilsaekjo came in without a break. The damage situation was being updated in real time.
The death toll, appearing only as astronomical numbers, felt unreal.
Suddenly, Jin stopped walking.
It was the front of Yuria's room. From beyond the closed door, the sound of stifled crying could be heard.
She, a contractor of Azmil, had been feeling a bad premonition about this situation for some time.
Perhaps Yuria had already become aware of the outcome of this situation.
Jin gently stroked the door several times as if to comfort her, then headed back to the launch site.
No matter what outcome she saw, he wanted to create a better future than that.
The Red Owl couldn't set coordinates for the Ziffel's main house. Jin landed in a forest on the outskirts of Drakka, where he met Ronil Ziffel right away.
He seemed to know that the Red Owl would arrive here.
"You're here, Lord Jin."
Jin didn't ask how he had known and waited in advance.
It was not the situation to find out, and the important issue now was Difus.
"Lord Ronil."
"Thank you for coming right away, I will guide you."
The autonomous district where Jin landed had been attacked by Difus. The damage wasn't very big since it was near the headquarters, but the whole city was soaked in fear.
The disaster that occurred in Milkun and other federations could not be covered by controlling the media.
"While requesting support from Tikan, there was another attack."
Ronil said as they boarded the Ziffel's 4th warship, Andion.
"In the meantime, has there been another massive troop movement?"

"No. Difus Runkandel attacked Barkl Autonomous District with two black knights. Since we were prepared, the civilian damage is not very big… but the Ghost Captain has been severely injured. Lord Kadun also fell into internal injuries while fighting in a body that hasn't fully recovered."
My brother Difus.
Jin, about to start speaking like that, looked out through the ship's window. This land was now filled with people he had killed or hurt.
"…What happened to the 4th squad?"
"Like the first attack, they didn't suffer any damage and escaped. It seems like they got a lot of power from the Evil Spirit…"
According to Ronil, Difus had not only dimensional movement through the power of the Evil Spirit and the prophet's land tunnel but also flying ability like a veil.
So, he's repetitively striking and running with his overwhelming mobility.
A piece of the Evil Spirit.
Ziffel had defined him as such. Difus possessed a power that was hard to accept unless he had received part of the Evil Spirit's authority.
Andion arrived at Ziffel's main house. Ziffel's castle, known as the mountain of magic, was unusually fully open and bustling with civilians. They were accommodating the civilians sick with fear.
As Jin got off Andion, they pointed fingers at him and bowed their heads as if a savior had come.
The former was because Jin, after all, was a Runkandel like the Evil Spirit and Difus, and the latter was thinking about his actions.
Just as Ronil was about to order the crowd to clear out, Jin stopped him.
"Better leave them be."
Jin passed them by and entered the inner building.
Relatives of Ziffel, with nothing to hide, were running around non-stop.
The only ones not running were those who looked like senior elders. They didn't show respect like Ronil even when they hastily saw Jin.
Rather, many of them frowned as if they were dissatisfied or showed obvious hostility.

Of course, given the situation, Jin didn't pay attention to the grudges of the old graybeards, but the elders naturally followed Jin and Ronil. As if they also had to hear the conversation between the supreme decision maker and Jin.
They passed through two halls and arrived at the office of the Ziffel family head. Where Kelliac should have been, there was Veradin.
"We meet again, Jin."
"Veradin."
Despite the fact that many civilians under Ziffel's protection had died, Octavia and Kadun were injured again and there were severe troop losses.
Veradin showed no signs of being depressed. He frowned as if he was more annoyed by the elders who followed Jin than the catastrophe Ziffel had experienced.
"What brings the elders here?"
"What do you mean, young head of the family? Naturally, we want to attend the meeting..."
"If you're incompetent, you should at least have good intuition or be busy. Well, since you've taken the trouble to come, listen if you're curious. It won't take long."
The elders grimaced. But they didn't dare to contradict Veradin's words.
"You seem quite flustered."
"Your relaxed attitude suggests otherwise. I just heard that the 4th squad attacked the Barkl Autonomous District. Is there a reason you can still be peaceful?"

"About a hundred civilians died. The Ghost Captain and Lord Kadun were injured, but the 4th squad faced them both without any damage. So, they should have been fine even if they had turned Barkl into a mess and advanced to Drakka, but they stopped, there must be a reason."
"Then why did you urgently request support from the Barmel Federation? Is it for post-recovery?"
At that, Veradin grinned.

"That's a strange question. Isn't it natural for a temporary alliance? Above all, we have to prevent the despair that the Evil Spirit acquires from growing... We have to save the hostages. As soon as the 2nd squad and the 4th squad began their operations, the despair that is devoted to the Evil Spirit is rapidly increasing."
As Veradin talked about 'despair', Jin's eyes widened.
Ziffel already knew about the size of the despair that Rosa was harvesting.
